The machine head is painted black with gold/yellow decorative lettering.
The brand name 'LION' is visible on the front of the machine head in photo 0.
The table has a dark wood finish with visible wear and scratches.
The machine is mounted on a dark wooden stand with a foot pedal assembly.

risks.proof: A video showing the machine powered on and sewing through fabric.

risks.risk: The table may be structurally unstable or have a warped surface.
risks.proof: A photo of the table with a ruler or tape measure showing the tabletop dimensions.

risks.risk: The machine may have internal rust or mechanical wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the bobbin area and the underside of the machine head.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing a piece of fabric.
Close-up photos of the machine head and the underside of the table.
Photos of the machine's serial number plate and the table's manufacturer's plate.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
